LiveChatTranscriptShare.name: LiveChatTranscriptShare
LiveChatTranscriptShare.description: Represents a sharing entry on a LiveChatTranscript object.

AccessLevel.description: Level of access that the User or Group has to the LiveChatTranscript. The possible values are: Read Edit All (This value is not valid for create() or update() calls.) This value must be set to an access level that is higher than the organization’s default access level for live chat transcripts.

ParentId.description: ID of the parent object, if any

RowCause.description: Reason that this sharing entry exists. If you’re creating a sharing entry, the only permitted value is Manual. If no value is specified, the field defaults to Manual. All other RowCause values are read-only. After the sharing entry is created, this field can’t be edited.

UserOrGroupID.description: ID of the User or Group that has been given access to the LiveChatTranscript.
